summary: All three files contain genuine formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. G8.lean defines GF(8) as triples of bits with explicit multiplication, inverse, and decidable instances, proving its field axioms by `decide`. VectorSpaces.lean develops the theory distinguishing GF(p)ⁿ (product ring) from GF(pⁿ) (field), with module instances, basis constructions, dimension calculations, zero-divisor proofs, linear equivalence between the two as vector spaces, and non-equivalence as rings.
